mechanism_narrative: The consistent week-over-week recovery observed across multiple mobility categories, including RETAIL_REC itself, indicates a general trend towards increased out-of-home activity. This sustained recovery will continue to drive RETAIL_REC higher over the next four weeks as people gradually return to pre-pandemic routines.
failure_condition: If the average RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than the average of the last 28 days, this hypothesis is falsified.

candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises by more than 2 points week-on-week
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES rises by more than 2 points week-on-week but RETAIL_REC does not increase over the subsequent two weeks compared to the prior two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: The broad-based recovery across all out-of-home mobility categories (RETAIL_REC, GROCERY_PHARM, PARKS, TRANSIT, WORKPLACES) strongly implies an underlying easing of public health restrictions or a shift in official guidance.
